emptyDescription: Build your own overview of the workspace: clock, weather, calendar, and data from any section — servers, mail, services.
editHintDesktop: Drag widgets by their header, and resize them from the handle in the bottom-right corner.
editHintMobile: On a narrow screen widgets stack into one column. The layout can be changed on screens wider than 640 pixels.
emptyBoardTitle: This dashboard has no widgets yet
emptyBoardDescription: Add the first widget — a clock, the weather, or a summary from any section.
deleteDialogDescription: The dashboard “{name}” and all of its widgets will be deleted. Section data is not affected.
widgetPickerDescription: Choose what to show on the dashboard.
titlePlaceholder: Leave empty for the default title

CLOCK.title: Clock and date
CLOCK.description: Current time and date, optionally in another time zone.

WEATHER.title: Weather
WEATHER.description: Current weather for a pair of coordinates — data from Open-Meteo.

CALENDAR.title: Calendar
CALENDAR.description: A month grid marking the days that had alerts, incidents, mail, or operator actions.

NOTE.title: Note
NOTE.description: Free-form text: who is on duty, contacts, reminders.

BOOKMARKS.title: Bookmarks
BOOKMARKS.description: Link tiles from a chosen bookmark category.

SERVICE_STATUS.title: Service status
SERVICE_STATUS.description: Monitoring summary: what is up and what is down.

SERVER_METRICS.title: Server metrics
SERVER_METRICS.description: CPU, memory, and disk usage reported by the metrics agent.

MAIL.title: Mail
MAIL.description: The most recent messages, optionally unread only.

ALERTS.title: Alerts
ALERTS.description: The most recent alerts, filtered by severity.

LOGS.title: Logs
LOGS.description: The most recent log entries, filtered by level.

clock.timeZoneHint: Leave empty to use the browser's zone.

calendar.monthNavigationHint: The calendar shows the current month.
